scientific_integrity: An explicit finite discrete-Morse certificate with 606 matched incidences proves the homotopy theorem; a standalone standard-library verifier exhaustively checks 4344 Hasse incidences, 502 genuine collapses and mod-two boundary ranks. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the 24-vertex adjacent-swap Cayley graph of S4 and intrinsic closed radius-3/2 vertex-centered balls are classified. The graph-metric Rips comparison is mod-two second homology, not an integral Rips homotopy theorem. No other scales or groups are classified. Unindexed equivalent work is possible.
title: The scale-three Čech nerve of the four-permutohedron is \(\bigvee^{17}S^2\)
